lines.text: The Story method helps you remember a list in the right order.
Here is a list: rocket, guitar, tomato, crown, penguin.
Link the first item to the second. A huge rocket crashes into a guitar ... and the guitar plays a loud song.
The song is so loud that a giant tomato bursts ... splash!
Out of the tomato rolls a shiny golden crown.
A little penguin puts on the crown and waddles like a king.
Now walk the story again: rocket, guitar, tomato, crown, penguin. Each picture brings back the next.
Make your pictures big, funny and moving. Your own story works best — now it’s your turn.
